title: registration_assignment
description: The decision that puts a registration request into a scheduled class: this party is in, in overflow, or waitlisted for this class. A request is not a registration; an assignment is what processing writes after it decides. It links a request to a class and says how many seats it takes. It carries no personal details: names and contacts stay on the request. Fields marked readOnly are set by the server only. Endpoint rules the schema cannot express: request_id and scheduled_class_id must exist; attendee_count may not exceed the request's attendee_count; the class's registered_count counts accepted and overflow seats only; a request can have more than one assignment over time (for example waitlisted, then accepted), and each change is a new linked record, never an overwrite. Payments are recorded as transaction_records; this record holds only their ids.
x_retention: Keep assignments until the owner deletes them. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

request_id.description: UUID of the registration request being decided. Required.

scheduled_class_id.description: UUID of the scheduled class the party is assigned to. For a private or group request this is the class processing created from it. Required.

status.description: The decision: accepted (a seat up to the class target), overflow (a seat between target and maximum), waitlisted (waiting for a seat), declined (not given a seat) or cancelled (was in, now out). Required.

attendee_count.description: How many seats this decision covers. May be fewer than the request asked for. 1 to 50. Required.

decision_note.description: Why, in the organizer's words. Free text.

transaction_record_ids.description: UUIDs of the transaction records (payments and refunds) that belong to this assignment. Only ids are kept here; who paid whom, how much and how live on the transaction record. Optional; added as payments are recorded.

program_slug.description: Which program this assignment belongs to, copied from the class. Set by the server.

decided_at.description: When the decision was made. Set by the server.

decided_by.description: Who made the decision, as an actor string such as user:<uuid> or system:<handler>. Set by the server.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id. Never sent by a browser.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created. Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created the record, as an actor string such as user:<uuid> or system:<handler>. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed. Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed the record, as an actor string. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard, import or system (an automated handler). Set by the server.

previous_id.description: Id of the earlier assignment this one replaces, for example when a waitlisted party is later accepted as a new record. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted. Records are never hard deleted. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted the record, as an actor string. Set by the server.
